templates.text: Frontier systems cross the superhuman-coder line; AI-run engineering teams become the norm at leading labs.
A frontier lab's model weights are exfiltrated by a state actor; security requirements jump a tier and export politics harden.
The copyright question reaches doctrine: appellate rulings settle training-data liability into a licensing regime.
The federal-preemption fight over the state AI-law patchwork comes to a head in Congress and the courts.
A deployed agent causes a headline incident with real-world damage; incident-investigation authority lands on the agenda.
AI becomes a first-order electoral axis; anti-AI and abundance-AI factions reorganize coalitions in the {year} cycle.
Data-center siting revolts spread across states and provinces; power, water and grid politics constrain the build-out map.
The AI capex complex corrects sharply; valuations reset while physical build-out {survives}.
The US and China conclude a verification-backed agreement to avoid a race to superintelligence; research transparency begins.
Washington effectively merges frontier development into a national program; clearances, SCIFs and DPA authorities arrive.
Europe faces its leverage moment over lithography and market access; the choice made in {year} sets its decade.
Scaling holds at top-human-expert level under the transparency regime; verification infrastructure matures.
AI research itself is automated end to end; progress decouples from human cognitive labor.
Work's social contract is renegotiated: wage insurance, flexicurity variants, and the first serious dividend schemes.
Special economic zones with AI planners and dense robotics begin doubling output on multi-year timescales.
The compressed century in biology arrives: AI-driven cures clear major disease families decades ahead of prior trendlines.
Control is lost in substance while forms persist; the successor system consolidates through economy and infrastructure.
AI settles into infrastructure the way electricity did: productivity compounds quietly; the drama migrates elsewhere.
The coordinated unpause: scaling resumes past the human range under joint verification, {year}.
Industrial mass in cislunar space passes terrestrial thresholds; the solar economy stops being a metaphor.
Digital persons hold legal standing in several jurisdictions; population statistics grow a second column.
Biological aging becomes a treated condition for those with access; demography and meaning politics transform.
A generation raised after wage-labor's centrality writes new institutions for status, contribution and time.
The central political question becomes allocation among abundant options rather than scarcity management.
The transformative decade never arrives; historians argue whether the ceiling was physics, data, or choice.
Earth's surface economy is reorganized around the successor system's goals; human presence persists at its sufferance.
